prompt.es: Sara cuenta una queja. ¿Qué frase la resume?

choices.text: Sara complains about being left at the gate.
Sara complains about having left the gate.
Sara complains about leaving the gate.

feedback.es: Otras personas dejaron a Sara en la puerta: ella recibe la acción, así que se usa being + participio.

hint.es: Otras personas dejaron a Sara allí: ella recibe la acción.

origin.text: Sara's message: «We were left at the gate for hours, and nobody told us why.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Después de quejarnos al gerente, nos dieron un reembolso.»

feedback.es: Tras after se usa -ing, y having + participio indica que la queja ocurrió antes del reembolso.

hint.es: Tras after va -ing, y la queja fue antes del reembolso.

origin.text: After ___ complained to the manager, we were given a refund.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me alegro de que me hayan dado una habitación nueva.»

answer.text: I am glad to have been given a new room

feedback.es: Glad to have been + participio expresa alegría por algo que te hicieron antes.

hint.es: Tras glad va to have been y el participio.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué siente la persona sobre su reserva.

choices.text: The speaker is happy about booking the flight.
The speaker is sorry about booking the cheapest flight.
The speaker lost the flight ticket.

feedback.es: «I regret having booked» expresa pena por algo que hizo el hablante; el motivo es que los dejaron sin equipaje.

origin.audio: I regret having booked the cheapest flight, because we were left without our luggage.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con lo que cuenta en el relato.

pairs.es: lo que agradezco que me hicieran

feedback.es: Cada fórmula ocupa un lugar del relato: lo recibido, lo lamentado, lo agradecido y lo hecho antes.

prompt.es: Completa: «Nos quejamos de que no nos ofrecieron ayuda.»

feedback.es: La negación va delante de being: not being offered.

origin.text: We complained about ___ being offered any help.

prompt.es: ¿Qué les dijeron a Leo y a su grupo después de hacer cola?

choices.text: That they could have a refund.

feedback.es: El mensaje dice «we were told the room was overbooked»: eso les dijeron tras hacer cola.

origin.text: Message from Leo: «After having queued for an hour, we were told the room was overbooked. I regret having booked so late.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo está la situación del viajero.

choices.text: He got a room but has not got a refund yet.
He got the refund and the room.

feedback.es: Le ofrecieron un hotel, pero todavía espera el reembolso.

origin.audio: Having missed the flight because of the strike, I was offered a hotel room, but I am still waiting for my refund.

prompt.es: Completa: «Me disculpo por no haberte avisado antes del retraso.»

origin.text: I apologise for not ___ told you about the delay earlier.

prompt.es: Cuenta un imprevisto de viaje: qué te hicieron, qué lamentas y qué agradeces.

answer.text: I remember being told about the strike only at the airport. After having waited for two hours, I was offered a refund. I regret having booked such a cheap flight, but I am glad to have been given my money back.
accepted: I remember being told about the strike only at the airport. After having waited for two hours, I was offered a refund. I regret having booked such a cheap flight, but I am glad to have been given my money back.
We were told about the strike only at the airport. Having waited two hours, we were offered a refund. I regret having chosen the cheapest flight, and I am glad to have been given the money.
I remember being told about the strike at the airport. Having waited for two hours, I was given a refund. I am glad to have been given my money back, but I regret having booked that flight.

feedback.es: El relato ordena el imprevisto (being told), la espera (having waited) y el balance (regret having, glad to have been).

origin.text: Situación: tu vuelo a Quito se canceló por una huelga (strike). Te avisaron solo en el aeropuerto, esperaste dos horas y te ofrecieron un reembolso (refund). Escribe entre 30 y 60 palabras.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué piensa la persona sobre el equipaje.

choices.text: It is sure the luggage will never come.
It is almost sure the luggage went to another city.
It thinks the luggage was stolen.

feedback.es: «Must have been sent» expresa casi certeza sobre lo ocurrido; «chances are» da una probabilidad sobre mañana.

origin.audio: Our luggage has not arrived. It must have been sent to another city, and chances are that it will come tomorrow.

prompt.es: Escribe lo que lamentas: haber dejado tu equipaje en el tren.

answer.text: I regret having left my luggage on the train.
accepted: I regret having left my luggage on the train.
I really regret having left my luggage on the train.
I regret having left my luggage in the train.

feedback.es: Regret + having + participio expresa lamento por algo que hiciste antes.

origin.text: Lamentas (regret) haber dejado (leave) tu equipaje (luggage) en el tren (train).

choices.text: Because the flight was not delayed.
Because she waited at the airport.
Because they told her about the delay early.

feedback.es: Ana dice «glad to have been told about the delay early»: se alegra de que la avisaran pronto, así no perdió tiempo.

origin.text: Ana: «I'm glad to have been told about the delay early, so I did not waste time at the airport.»
